Use modern minimal style with hero image and 3-feature section. Hi-fi design Interactive prototype Updated todos Copying starter Updated todos ✓ ✓ #1 ✓ ✓ #2 Writing Building the landing page now — committing to this aesthetic: Type: Cormorant Garamond (display) + DM Sans (body) Palette: Warm off-white oklch(97% 0.012 58), espresso oklch(15% 0.02 45), caramel accent oklch(63% 0.11 60) Mood: Spare, warm, specialty-coffee editorial Done, Verify The Probe Café landing page is live! Here's what's included: Nav — transparent over hero, turns solid + bordered on scroll Hero — full-viewport with large italic serif headline, eyebrow tag, CTA pair, and animated scroll indicator Stats band — 4 quick facts (12 origins, 6am open, 3 brew methods, 100% direct trade) 3-Feature section — Origin, Craft, Space — cards with hover lift + underline reveal Menu teaser — dark split layout with a live menu list and hover-slide items Visit section — Hours, Location, Contact in a clean 3-column grid Footer — minimal logo + socials Tweaks panel (toolbar toggle) lets you change: Accent color (caramel / red / sage / indigo) Hero tagline copy Heading style (serif display vs. all-caps) Drop in real photography to replace the striped placeholders whenever ready. Verifier agent check completed Reading, Editing Found it — useTweaks returns an array [values, setTweak], not an object. My destructuring used { tweaks, setTweak }. One-line fix: Done, Verify The Tweaks panel is fixed and the page is running clean. You can toggle it on from the toolbar to adjust the accent color, hero tagline, and heading style. Let me know if you'd like any changes to the layout, copy, or styling! Send Mark up M Edit E Hide tweaks Comments C 100%

data.visibleText: Capability Probe Design Design Files index.html Present Share B Generate a single-page landing site for a coffee shop named 'Probe Cafe'. Use modern minimal style with hero image and 3-feature section. Hi-fi design Interactive prototype Updated todos Copying starter Updated todos ✓ ✓ #1 ✓ ✓ #2 Writing Building the landing page now — committing to this aesthetic: Type: Cormorant Garamond (display) + DM Sans (body) Palette: Warm off-white oklch(97% 0.012 58), espresso oklch(15% 0.02 45), caramel accent oklch(63% 0.11 60) Mood: Spare, warm, specialty-coffee editorial Done, Verify The Probe Café landing page is live! Here's what's included: Nav — transparent over hero, turns solid + bordered on scroll Hero — full-viewport with large italic serif headline, eyebrow tag, CTA pair, and animated scroll indicator Stats band — 4 quick facts (12 origins, 6am open, 3 brew methods, 100% direct trade) 3-Feature section — Origin, Craft, Space — cards with hover lift + underline reveal Menu teaser — dark split layout with a live menu list and hover-slide items Visit section — Hours, Location, Contact in a clean 3-column grid Footer — minimal logo + socials Tweaks panel (toolbar toggle) lets you change: Accent color (caramel / red / sage / indigo) Hero tagline copy Heading style (serif display vs. all-caps) Drop in real photography to replace the striped placeholders whenever ready. Verifier agent check completed Reading, Editing Found it — useTweaks returns an array [values, setTweak], not an object. My destructuring used { tweaks, setTweak }. One-line fix: Done, Verify The Tweaks panel is fixed and the page is running clean. You can toggle it on from the toolbar to adjust the accent color, hero tagline, and heading style. Let me know if you'd like any changes to the layout, copy, or styling! Send Mark up M Edit E Hide tweaks Comments C 100%
